# PLC tag reference

**Generated by `scripts/gen_plc_docs.py` from `qd_plc/tags.py` - do not edit by hand.**

Two Modbus links, two different maps. Map A is the machine interface between the robot controller and the cell PLC; Map B is the supervisory view between the PLC and the operator panel. They are deliberately not the same set of signals.

Scaling: Modbus carries 16-bit words only, so every physical value is an integer with an agreed scale (`8.42 mm` travels as `842`). `qd_plc/datastore.py` applies each tag's scale on the way in and out.

---

## OpenPLC slave-device configuration

Type these into **Slave Devices -> Add** in the OpenPLC web UI, for a Generic Modbus TCP device on port 5020. Use the Mac's **IPv4 address** as seen from the container, not `host.docker.internal` - OpenPLC's Modbus master cannot resolve hostnames. `scripts/plc_configure.py` looks it up for you. **Order and size matter**: OpenPLC derives every `%`-address from them, so resizing a block silently shifts everything after it.

| Field | Start | Size | Resulting `%` range |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Discrete Inputs | 0 | 32 | %IX100.0 - %IX103.7 |
| Coils | 0 | 16 | %QX100.0 - %QX101.7 |
| Input Registers | 0 | 32 | %IW100 - %IW131 |
| Holding Registers - Read | 0 | 0 | unused - leave zero |
| Holding Registers - Write | 0 | 16 | %QW100 - %QW115 |

Holding Registers - Read is sized **0** on purpose: everything the PLC reads from the sim is already an input register, and a second copy would be a second source of truth for the same words.

---

## Map A - Sim-side Modbus slave (OpenPLC polls this). The machine interface: gate handshake, status bits, measured values.

Sim listens on `0.0.0.0:5020`, unit 1. Binding loopback instead is the most common reason OpenPLC reports the slave offline.

Bits marked **sticky** are latched set-only by the sim and cleared only by the `CLEAR_STICKY` coil. The sim free-runs far faster than OpenPLC polls, so an unlatched transient could be raised and cleared entirely between two polls and never be seen.

### Discrete Inputs (sim reads nothing here; PLC polls these as status)

| Addr | IEC | Name | Type | Scale | Sticky | Description |
|---:|---|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| 1 | `%IX100.1` | `SIM_READY` | bool |  |  | Model loaded, server up, ready to be started |
| 2 | `%IX100.2` | `BUSY` | bool |  |  | Executing a phase (not sitting at a gate) |
| 3 | `%IX100.3` | `GATED` | bool |  |  | Parked at a gate, waiting for PERMIT |
| 4 | `%IX100.4` | `PHASE_DONE` | bool |  | yes | Set on reaching any gate; cleared by PHASE_ACK |
| 7 | `%IX100.7` | `SESSION_DONE` | bool |  |  | All QDs installed and all ports leak-tested |
| 8 | `%IX101.0` | `QD_GRASPED` | bool |  |  | Part is held (kinematic weld engaged) |
| 9 | `%IX101.1` | `QD_SEATED` | bool |  |  | Thread face has reached port depth right now |
| 10 | `%IX101.2` | `GRIPPER_OPEN` | bool |  |  |  |
| 11 | `%IX101.3` | `PART_DETECTED` | bool |  |  | Last survey returned at least one candidate |
| 12 | `%IX101.4` | `VISION_FALLBACK` | bool |  | yes | A survey gave up and used the taught position |
| 13 | `%IX101.5` | `VISION_COASTING` | bool |  |  | Tracking with no current detection |
| 15 | `%IX101.7` | `SELF_COLLISION` | bool |  | yes |  |
| 16 | `%IX102.0` | `LEAK_CONTACT` | bool |  | yes | Leak arm touched a QD or the manifold |
| 17 | `%IX102.1` | `MAXSTEPS_EXPIRED` | bool |  | yes | A motion step hit its step cap - the otherwise silent hang |
| 19 | `%IX102.3` | `SEAT_SHORTFALL` | bool |  | yes | Screw phase ended short of the depth target |
| 20 | `%IX102.4` | `ACTIVE_ARM_LEAK` | bool |  |  | 0 = pick arm is active, 1 = leak arm is active |
| 21 | `%IX102.5` | `ABORT_COMPLETE` | bool |  |  | Parked and video flushed after an ABORT |
| 22 | `%IX102.6` | `SIM_STOPPED` | bool |  |  |  |
| 23 | `%IX102.7` | `LIVE_WINDOW_OPEN` | bool |  |  | Vision display alive; 0 means the operator closed it |
| 24 | `%IX103.0` | `PERMIT_MISMATCH` | bool |  | yes | A permit arrived for a stale phase/sequence and was refused |
| 25 | `%IX103.1` | `GATE_TIMEOUT` | bool |  | yes | Sim-side safety: waited longer than GATE_TIMEOUT_S at a gate |

Spare: 0-31 (declared block size 32; reserved so a later addition does not shift the addresses above).

### Coils (commands)

| Addr | IEC | Name | Type | Scale | Sticky | Description |
|---:|---|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| 0 | `%QX100.0` | `PERMIT` | bool |  |  | Release the currently gated phase (validated against HR0/HR1) |
| 1 | `%QX100.1` | `PHASE_ACK` | bool |  |  | Clears PHASE_DONE |
| 2 | `%QX100.2` | `RUN` | bool |  |  | Master enable; dropping it holds the sim at the next gate |
| 3 | `%QX100.3` | `HOLD` | bool |  |  | Freeze where it stands, mid-motion; dropping it resumes |
| 4 | `%QX100.4` | `ABORT` | bool |  |  | Graceful: finish the tick, park, flush video, set ABORT_COMPLETE |
| 5 | `%QX100.5` | `CLEAR_STICKY` | bool |  |  | The only way sticky status bits are ever cleared |

Spare: 6-15 (declared block size 16; reserved so a later addition does not shift the addresses above).

### Input Registers (measured values, read-only to the master)

| Addr | IEC | Name | Type | Scale | Sticky | Description |
|---:|---|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| 0 | `%IW100` | `PHASE_CODE` | enum | enum Phase |  |  |
| 1 | `%IW101` | `PHASE_SEQ` | uint16 | count |  | Increments at every gate; the permit must echo it back |
| 5 | `%IW105` | `PORT_ID` | uint16 | count |  | 1..4, 0 = none |
| 6 | `%IW106` | `INSERT_DEPTH` | uint16 | 0.01 mm |  | How far the thread face has entered the port |
| 9 | `%IW109` | `TILT_DEG` | int16 | 0.01 deg |  | Grasp tilt from vertical - a genuine quality metric |
| 10 | `%IW110` | `TRACK_DIFF` | uint16 | 0.01 mm |  | Vision-tracked position vs the taught reference |
| 13 | `%IW113` | `SELF_COLL_PEAK` | uint16 | count |  |  |
| 14 | `%IW114` | `LEAK_CONTACT_PEAK` | uint16 | count |  |  |
| 19 | `%IW119` | `SIM_TICK` | uint16 | ticks |  | Free-running step counter, wraps at 65535; the comms heartbeat |
| 22 | `%IW122` | `QDS_INSTALLED` | uint16 | count |  |  |
| 23 | `%IW123` | `LEAK_TESTED` | uint16 | count |  |  |

Spare: 2-31 (declared block size 32; reserved so a later addition does not shift the addresses above).

### Holding Registers (setpoints)

| Addr | IEC | Name | Type | Scale | Sticky | Description |
|---:|---|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| 0 | `%QW100` | `PERMIT_PHASE` | enum | enum Phase |  | Which phase the PLC believes it is permitting |
| 1 | `%QW101` | `PERMIT_SEQ` | uint16 | count |  | The anti-stale guard: must equal PHASE_SEQ or PERMIT is refused |
| 7 | `%QW107` | `GATE_TIMEOUT_S` | uint16 | s |  | 0 = wait forever |

Spare: 2-15 (declared block size 16; reserved so a later addition does not shift the addresses above).

## Map B - PLC-side Modbus slave (the HMI polls this). The supervisory view: cell state, progress, the active fault, pushbuttons.

An IEC 61131 program cannot write `%IX` or `%IW`, and in OpenPLC that space is taken by the master mapping. So PLC-to-HMI status lives in coils and holding registers with an ownership split by address range rather than by object type:

| Range | Written by | Read by |
|---|---|---|
| coils 0-15 | PLC | HMI |
| coils 80-95 | HMI | PLC |
| registers 0-35 | PLC | HMI |

Anything at `%QX100.0`/`%QW100` or above belongs to the sim link and is out of bounds for the HMI.

### Coils (commands)

| Addr | IEC | Name | Type | Scale | Sticky | Description |
|---:|---|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| 6 | `%QX0.6` | `SIM_COMM_OK` | bool |  |  | The robot's heartbeat is advancing |
| 10 | `%QX1.2` | `LEAK_PHASE_ACTIVE` | bool |  |  | The leak arm has the cell |
| 11 | `%QX1.3` | `LEAK_ARMED` | bool |  |  | Operator has started the leak section; permits G8-G10 |
| 12 | `%QX1.4` | `SAFE_TO_START` | bool |  |  | Every interlock for a fresh start is satisfied |
| 80 | `%QX10.0` | `HMI_START` | bool |  |  |  |
| 81 | `%QX10.1` | `HMI_STOP` | bool |  |  |  |
| 82 | `%QX10.2` | `HMI_RESET` | bool |  |  |  |
| 89 | `%QX11.1` | `HMI_START_LEAK` | bool |  |  | Momentary: arm the leak section |
| 90 | `%QX11.2` | `HMI_STOP_LEAK` | bool |  |  | Momentary: disarm it, or stop the leak arm if it is moving |

Spare: 0-95 (declared block size 96; reserved so a later addition does not shift the addresses above).

### Holding Registers (setpoints)

| Addr | IEC | Name | Type | Scale | Sticky | Description |
|---:|---|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| 0 | `%QW0` | `CELL_STATE` | enum | enum CellState |  |  |
| 1 | `%QW1` | `CURRENT_STEP` | enum | enum Phase |  |  |
| 15 | `%QW15` | `ACTIVE_FAULT_CODE` | enum | enum Fault |  |  |
| 25 | `%QW25` | `LEAK_TESTED` | uint16 | count |  |  |
| 32 | `%QW32` | `QDS_INSTALLED` | uint16 | count |  |  |

Spare: 2-35 (declared block size 36; reserved so a later addition does not shift the addresses above).

## Enumerations

### Phase (PHASE_CODE, CURRENT_STEP)

| Value | Name | Operator text |
|---:|---|---|
| 0 | `IDLE` | Idle |
| 1 | `WAIT_START` | Waiting for start |
| 10 | `SURVEY_TRAY` | Surveying tray |
| 11 | `FLY_HOVER_TRAY` | Moving to tray |
| 12 | `TRACK_QD` | Tracking QD |
| 20 | `PICK_APPROACH` | Approaching QD |
| 21 | `PICK_DESCEND` | Descending to QD |
| 22 | `PICK_GRASP` | Grasping |
| 23 | `PICK_LIFT` | Lifting |
| 30 | `SURVEY_PORTS` | Surveying ports |
| 31 | `FLY_HOVER_PORT` | Moving to manifold |
| 32 | `TRACK_PORT` | Tracking port |
| 40 | `TRANSPORT_TO_PORT_ABOVE` | Moving above port |
| 41 | `TRANSPORT_DESCEND_PRE_INSERT` | Descending to pre-insert |
| 50 | `SCREW_IN` | Screwing in |
| 51 | `SCREW_DECEL` | Stopping rotation |
| 53 | `GRIPPER_RELEASE` | Opening gripper |
| 55 | `POST_SCREW_RISE` | Retracting |
| 56 | `UNWIND` | Unwinding tool |
| 57 | `CYCLE_END` | Cycle complete |
| 60 | `FLY_READY` | Returning to ready |
| 70 | `LEAK_PREP` | Preparing leak test |
| 72 | `LEAK_SURVEY` | Surveying flanges |
| 73 | `LEAK_TO_PORT_ABOVE` | Moving above flange |
| 74 | `LEAK_HOVER_DETECT` | Detecting seam |
| 75 | `LEAK_ORBIT_SEAM` | Tracing seam |
| 76 | `LEAK_RETRACT` | Retracting probe |
| 77 | `LEAK_PORT_DONE` | Port tested |
| 90 | `SESSION_COMPLETE` | Session complete |

Phase codes are decade-aligned, so a code reads as its stage at a glance: 10s the tray, 20s the pick, and so on.

### CellState (Map B CELL_STATE)

| Value | Name | Operator text |
|---:|---|---|
| 0 | `IDLE` |  |
| 1 | `STARTING` |  |
| 2 | `RUNNING` |  |
| 3 | `HOLD` |  |
| 4 | `FAULTING` |  |
| 5 | `FAULTED` |  |
| 6 | `COMPLETE` |  |
| 7 | `ABORTING` |  |

### Fault (ACTIVE_FAULT_CODE)

| Value | Name | Operator text |
|---:|---|---|
| 0 | `NONE` |  |
| 1 | `SIM_COMM_LOSS` | Lost communication with robot controller |
| 2 | `GATE_TIMEOUT` | Robot did not release from gate within timeout |
| 3 | `PHASE_WATCHDOG` | Step exceeded its maximum time |
| 4 | `MAXSTEPS_EXPIRED` | Motion step hit its step limit without completing |
| 5 | `VISION_FALLBACK` | Vision failed; fell back to taught position |
| 6 | `VISION_COAST_EXCESS` | Vision lost for too long during tracking |
| 7 | `SELF_COLLISION` | Arm self-collision detected |
| 8 | `LEAK_ARM_CONTACT` | Leak-test arm contacted a part |
| 9 | `SEAT_SHORTFALL` | Part not seated to depth - release refused |
| 14 | `PERMIT_MISMATCH` | Permit did not match the requested step |
| 17 | `LIVE_WINDOW_CLOSED` | Vision display was closed |
